meta.title: Census 2021 origin-destination: residence vs place of work (LA)
meta.publisher: Office for National Statistics (Nomis bulk download)
meta.quality: Census 2021 table ODWP01EW (LTLA level), accredited official statistics; full count with cell-key perturbation. Centroids are ONS Dec-2021 LAD BUC label points (LAT/LONG) from the ONS Open Geography Portal.
meta.limitations: Census day (21 March 2021) fell in a national lockdown with ~1/3 of workers at home and many furloughed (furloughed workers still reported a workplace): commuting volumes are understated vs today and home-workers are excluded from flows. Small flows are noisy due to perturbation. LA codes are 2021 LTLAs (pre-2023 Cumbria/Somerset/N Yorks reorganisation). BEDS rows treat the three UAs as one area; its flow end uses the mean of the three UA centroids.

indicators.label: Workers commuting in, by home LA
indicators.description: People whose workplace is in the focus area, by LA of usual residence (top 25 + 'all other areas'); includes those living and working in the same LA (attrs.same_la). Excludes home-workers. attrs give origin/dest lat/lon for flow maps.

indicators.label: Residents commuting out, by workplace LA
indicators.description: Employed residents of the focus area travelling to a workplace, by LA of workplace (top 25 + remainder); excludes home-workers, offshore and outside-UK.

indicators.label: Workers travelling to a workplace in the area
indicators.description: All people travelling to a workplace in the area (any origin).

indicators.label: Residents travelling to a workplace
indicators.description: Employed residents travelling to a UK workplace (any destination).

indicators.label: Residents mainly working from home / no fixed place
indicators.description: Employed residents mainly working at or from home or with no fixed place (high in March 2021 lockdown).

indicators.label: Net commuting (in minus out)
indicators.description: Workplace commuters minus resident commuters; negative = net out-commuting.

indicators.label: Self-containment
indicators.description: % of resident commuters whose workplace is in the same area.

indicators.label: Workplace filled by in-commuters
indicators.description: % of people commuting to a workplace in the area who live outside it.
